questions.question: In cache-aside, who is responsible for populating the cache?
questions.explanation: In cache-aside, the application populates the cache on a cache miss.

faq.a: When many requests all miss the cache simultaneously and all hit the database at once. Use a mutex or probabilistic early expiry to prevent it.
